sonnet.problem: The card says the mighty men are 'under five commanders from Judah and Benjamin.' The text calls only Adnah and Jehohanan 'commander' (17:14-15). Amasiah is 'the volunteer for the LORD' (17:16). Eliada is 'a mighty man of valor' (17:17). Jehozabad has no title (17:18). Calling all five 'commanders' puts a title on three men that the text does not give them.
sonnet.rule: **Call things what the text calls them.**
